subject: Re: Renewal window + competitor bake-off request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@maplepay.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Chong <leah.chong@maplepay.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & competitive evaluation

Alex —

Quick note as we approach our January renewal: we’ve been approached by a rival who claims a 25% lower unit cost and simpler infra integrations. Internally we’re running a short evaluation window to validate throughput/latency under our 1M monthly token workload.

We value Redwood’s consistency but need concrete numbers and an updated term that reflects our growth. Can we do a focused bake-off (2 weeks) and a joint runbook so we can compare apples-to-apples?

Leah and I can share sample payloads and current model configs. Priority for us is tail latency (p95), cost per 1k tokens, and local failover behavior.

—Samir
MaplePay — Head of Platform

Attachment: current-traffic-sample.json (json)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@maplepay.com>
Cc: Leah Chong <leah.chong@maplepay.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & competitive evaluation

Samir —

Thanks for the heads up and the sample. We’re happy to run a structured bake-off. Proposed approach:

1) Two-week dedicated window (Dec 7–Dec 20) with a reserved pool sized for your 1M token profile.
2) Shared runbook with test vectors (you provide), our benchmark harness (we’ll run p50/p95/p99, cold start, model variant comparisons).
3) SLOs measured: p95 latency, tokens/sec throughput, error rate, and cost normalized to your workload.
4) A short joint readout and a term proposal (3/12/24 month options) within 48 hours after the run.

I’ll loop in Ben and Vanessa for capacity and Ops. Can you confirm whether you need on-prem/private connectivity or hosted endpoints? Also please share the traffic sample and critical prompt families we should prioritize.

If that timeline works we’ll prepare a scoped bakeoff sheet and a Ring-fenced Dedicated offer for the window.

—Alex Martinez
Principal Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-bakeoff-outline-v0.1.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & competitive evaluation — internal ops plan

Alex —

We can schedule a small Dedicated pool for MaplePay during Dec 7–20. Need to confirm:
- Target concurrent rps / token burst patterns (Samir to provide)
- Model family to test (gpt-like vs open-llama variants)
- Whether to enable KV prefix caching during run (recommended for realistic app perf)

Ops asks: Vanessa, can you reserve 2x A100 nodes in us-west-2 for the window and stand up the harness? Priya — can you prepare a 1-page benchmark runbook and the cost model scenarios (standard vs aggressively batched) so we can show tradeoffs?

I’ll also prep a fallback policy (auto-route to smaller quantized variant) we can test for graceful degradation.

—Ben
VP, Solutions Engineering

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@maplepay.com>
Cc: Leah Chong <leah.chong@maplepay.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & competitive evaluation — bake-off scope & MAP

Samir/Leah —

Thanks — based on Ben’s note we drafted a short mutual action plan (MAP) and scope doc. Key highlights:

- Run window: Dec 7 00:00 PST — Dec 20 23:59 PST
- Infrastructure: Redwood Dedicated pool (2x A100), isolated project, no cross-tenant sharing
- Tests: p50/p95/p99 latency, sustained throughput, cold-start, error modes, failover to quantized variant
- Success criteria: p95 <= 220ms AND cost delta <= 15% vs incumbent, or demonstrable ops/runtime benefits (cache hit improvements, reduced tail spikes)
- Deliverables: Benchmark results + recorded traces, cost model, term proposal (3/12/24m options) within 48h post-run
- Roles: MaplePay provides sample payloads + critical prompts; Redwood provides harness and runbook.

Attached: bakeoff scope spreadsheet and benchmark runbook. Can you confirm samples and a quick sync this Friday to finalize test vectors?

—Alex

Attachments: maplepay_bakeoff_scope_v1.xlsx; benchmark-runbook.md

From: Leah Chong <leah.chong@maplepay.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & competitive evaluation — bake-off scope & MAP

Alex/Team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We reviewed the MAP and agreed internally. A few clarifications:

- We’ll provide three days of representative traffic logs and a 20-sample prompt family list by EOD Friday (Nov 13).
- We want the run to include a short failover test to the quantized variant at the 50% load point to observe degradation behavior.
- For term proposals, can you include a Dedicated uplift discount tied to a 12-month commit? If the bake-off shows parity on cost/latency, we want to see a commit option that keeps unit economics within 10% of the incumbent.

Confirming a quick 30-min sync Friday 11/13 at 10am PST.

—Leah
Lead SRE, MaplePay

Attachment: maplepay_sample_requests.json (json)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Bake-off kickoff checklist + pricing options

Team —

Follow-up from Friday’s sync — Leah sent the sample payloads and we’re green to start prep. Action items before Dec 7:

1) Vanessa: reserve 2x A100s in us-west-2 and create isolated project (due Nov 25).
2) Ben: finalize harness with KV caching toggles and quantized fallback (due Nov 28).
3) Priya: build three term bundles (3m, 12m w/ tiered discount, 24m with prioritized capacity) and include explicit cost-per-1k-token numbers under the two batching scenarios. Make the 12m commit show <=10% delta target if bake-off parity achieved.
4) Alex: produce a short customer slide for the readout template and the post-run negotiation playbook.

I’ll post a pre-run smoke checklist to the Drive folder (link in metadata) and set daily 15m standups for Dec 7–20. Expect to need a one-off credits discussion if we need an aggressive discount to match the incumbent.

—Alex
Principal Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Related links: https://drive.redwood.ai/MaplePay/Bakeoff-Scope
